ADMINISTRATOR.label: Administrator
ADMINISTRATOR.description: Has every permission and ignores the channels' ones. Be careful giving it.

MANAGE_ROLES.label: Manage roles
MANAGE_ROLES.description: Create and edit roles below yours and the channels' permissions.

KICK_MEMBERS.label: Kick members
KICK_MEMBERS.description: Remove people below you from the server.

BAN_MEMBERS.label: Ban members
BAN_MEMBERS.description: Kick and keep from coming back.

CREATE_INVITE.label: Create invites
CREATE_INVITE.description: Invites also create new Aureum accounts.

CHANGE_NICKNAME.label: Change nickname
CHANGE_NICKNAME.description: Pick your own nickname on this server.

MANAGE_NICKNAMES.label: Manage nicknames
MANAGE_NICKNAMES.description: Change the nickname of people below you.

VIEW_CHANNEL.label: View channels
VIEW_CHANNEL.description: Without it the channel is invisible.

READ_HISTORY.label: Read history
READ_HISTORY.description: Without it, you only see what arrives while the channel is open.

ATTACH_FILES.label: Attach files
ATTACH_FILES.description: Images, videos, files and voice messages.

ADD_REACTIONS.label: React
ADD_REACTIONS.description: Create new reactions. Adding to an existing reaction doesn't need it.

USE_STICKERS.label: Use stickers
USE_STICKERS.description: Send Aureum's and this server's stickers.

MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS.label: Manage stickers
MANAGE_EXPRESSIONS.description: Upload, rename and remove the server's stickers.

MENTION_EVERYONE.label: Mention @everyone
MENTION_EVERYONE.description: Reserved: role mentions come in a future version.

MUTE_MEMBERS.label: Mute members
MUTE_MEMBERS.description: Turn off the microphone of people below you, until released.

DEAFEN_MEMBERS.label: Deafen members
DEAFEN_MEMBERS.description: Cut the audio (and microphone) of people below you.

MOVE_MEMBERS.label: Move members
MOVE_MEMBERS.description: Take people below you to another room.

USE_SOUNDBOARD.label: Use the soundboard
USE_SOUNDBOARD.description: Play the server's sounds in the room (needs Speak).

MANAGE_SOUNDBOARD.label: Manage sounds
MANAGE_SOUNDBOARD.description: Add, edit and remove the server's soundboard sounds.

MANAGE_ADDONS.label: Manage addons
MANAGE_ADDONS.description: Add, configure and delete addons (with Manage channels).

EDIT_WHITEBOARD.label: Edit whiteboard
EDIT_WHITEBOARD.description: Draw, write and create boards. Without it, view only.

MANAGE_EVENTS.label: Manage events
MANAGE_EVENTS.description: Create, edit and cancel events. People who manage addons can too. Everyone who sees the channel answers.

SEND_MESSAGES.label: Participate
SEND_MESSAGES.description: Change the addon's content (edit the page, move cards...).

MANAGE_ADDONS.label: Manage addon
MANAGE_ADDONS.description: Change the addon's settings and, with Manage channels, delete it.
